text: 54-year-old woman. The patient reports a skin lesion on her right leg that has been present for 1 month. The lesion began as a small red spot and has increased in size. speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and the lesion following an insect bite, I need to check for signs of infection or autoimmune involvement. Can you tell me if the edges of the ulcer are raised or if there is any pus, and have you noticed any similar lesions elsewhere on your body?

speaker: Doctor
text: The history of Crohn's disease and the description of a painful ulcer with purplish borders after minor trauma strongly suggests Pyoderma Gangrenosum.
